name: LockedCameraCapture
summary: Capture content with your app’s camera experience when the device is locked.

declarations.name: LockedCameraCaptureExtension
declarations.comment: A protocol that creates a locked camera capture extension.

members.name: configuration
members.comment: A read-only, computed configuration for the locked camera capture extension.

declarations.name: LockedCameraCaptureExtensionScene
declarations.comment:
A protocol that provides the UI for the locked camera capture extension.

Implement this protocol with the <doc:LockedCameraCapture/LockedCameraCaptureUIScene>
providing the UI.

declarations.name: LockedCameraCaptureManager
declarations.comment: An object that provides handling of captured content and transitioning to the extension's containing app.

members.name: sessionContentURLs
members.comment:
An array of URLs that each point to a directory containing captured content.

Content in the URLs is captured during a capture
extension's <doc:LockedCameraCapture/LockedCameraCaptureSession>. These
directories are located within the capture extension's containing app's data container.

members.name: endDelayingAppearance
members.comment: Tells the system that the application is ready to appear after delaying the appearance during a transition between the extension and the application

members.name: sessionContentUpdates
members.signature: final var sessionContentUpdates: some AsyncSequence<LockedCameraCaptureManager.SessionContentUpdate, Never> { get }
members.comment:
An `AsyncSequence` to process captured content from your capture extension.

Use this to process captured content as soon as it is available after your app launches.

members.name: beginDelayingAppearance
members.comment: Tells the system that the application wants to delay the application launch during a transition between the extension and the application

members.name: invalidateSessionContent
members.signature: final func invalidateSessionContent(at url: URL) async throws
members.comment:
Tells the system that the app no longer needs the directory at the URL and it can be deleted.

The directory at the `URL` contains captured content for a session. Store the captured content
appropriately before calling this method, otherwise the system deletes it.

- Parameter url: A URL from 
<doc:LockedCameraCapture/LockedCameraCaptureManager/sessionContentURLs>.
The system ignores other URLs.

members.name: shared
members.comment: The shared instance of the manager.

declarations.name: LockedCameraCaptureSession
declarations.comment:
An object that can request to open the extension's containing app and receives session configuration
updates.

Provided during the initialization of the 
<doc:LockedCameraCapture/LockedCameraCaptureExtensionScene>. Only the system can
initialize this object.

members.name: invalidateSessionContent
members.comment: Invalidates the contents of the session contents URL, deleting them. Note this does not remove the contents directory itself. This is useful in case the extension has already ingested its contents via PhotoKit and wishes to not persist any data (but can still use this directory as a working directory to recover from an unexpected termination).

members.name: openApplication
members.signature: final func openApplication(for userActivity: NSUserActivity) async throws
members.comment:
Initiates a request to open the extension's containing app.

The system requests authentication before opening the app, if needed.

- Parameter userActivity: An `NSUserActivity` that contains relevant information
to benefit from universal link support. Use the
<doc:NSUserActivityTypeLockedCameraCapture> activity type to indicate when the app
launches from a locked camera capture extension.

members.name: sessionContentURL
members.comment:
A temporary directory URL inside the extension's data container.

Store captured content during the current `LockedCameraCaptureSession` to this `URL`.

The system copies the contents of this directory to the extension's containing app's data container
when the extension is suspended. The extension's data container is erased once the
system finishes copying the contents. Store all data that needs to be persisted past the lifetime of
the extension process to this directory.

declarations.name: LockedCameraCaptureSession.ApplicationLaunchError
declarations.comment: Indicates why launching the extension's containing app failed.

members.name: errorDomain
members.comment: The domain for errors that can occur when launching the extension's containing app.

members.name: failureReason
members.comment: A string that describes the error that occurred.

members.name: errorCode
members.comment: An integer value that represents the error code.

declarations.name: LockedCameraCaptureUIScene
declarations.comment: A structure that contains the session object and UI to display for the locked camera capture extension.
